commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101; test -e "$PORT"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; echo '=== SONOFF PAIRING WINDOW 210S ==='; python - <<'PY'
import serial, time
port='/dev/cu.usbmodem1101'
s=serial.Serial()
s.port=port
s.baudrate=115200
s.timeout=0.20
s.write_timeout=1
s.dtr=False
s.rts=False
s.open()
start=time.monotonic(); end=start+210; sent=False
try:
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        if not sent and elapsed>=1:
            s.write(b'permit 180\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: permit 180', flush=True); sent=True
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            print(data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(), flush=True)
finally:
    s.close()
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
